Main_Finding: Thousands of genes differed between the CN_high, CN_low and Hypermutated subtypes.
GO and KEGG results highlighted subtype-associated ciliary, microtubule, immune and signalling pathways.
LASSO achieved 95.7% held-out TCGA accuracy and selected 56 unique genes.
Random Forest achieved 78.3% held-out TCGA accuracy and showed reduced sensitivity for Hypermutated tumours.
LASSO outperformed Random Forest using the same training and test partitions.
Accuracy fell to 56.4% for LASSO and 46.5% for Random Forest in the independent CPTAC cohort.
Eleven genes were supported by both machine-learning methods, including L1CAM, CLDN9, ACTL8 and HIF3A.
